status.description: done: brief complete and built. partial: some items left. needs_input: a decision only the user can make (put it in questions). blocked: cannot continue.

summary.description: Two to four plain sentences: what now works.

untested.description: Behaviour that needs real hardware, permissions or a person.

questions.description: Decisions for the user. Empty unless status is needs_input or partial.

notes.description: Anything the integrator must know: conflicts, skipped items, follow-ups.
